items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.a: The City of North Vancouver's Lonsdale Avenue corridor core — the shops and services around 13th–17th Streets, Lions Gate Hospital, City Hall and the City Library, the new Harry Jerome recreation centre at the north end, and the residential side streets between St. Georges and Chesterfield Avenues.

faq.q: Which schools are located in Central Lonsdale?
faq.a: Queen Mary Community Elementary (K–7), 230 Keith Road West, is inside the area and Carson Graham Secondary (8–12), 2145 Jones Avenue, is at its north end; catchments are address-based, and SD44's new Cloverley elementary school (opening 2026/27) may change elementary catchments east of Lonsdale — check the exact address with SD44.

faq.q: How do you commute downtown from Central Lonsdale?
faq.a: Route 230 buses run down Lonsdale Avenue to Lonsdale Quay, where the SeaBus crosses to Waterfront Station in 12 minutes; the R2 RapidBus on 3rd Street / Marine Drive now runs one-seat from Park Royal through Lonsdale Quay to Metrotown.

faq.q: What does the Lonsdale Great Street Plan mean for the area?
faq.a: Council approved it April 20, 2026 as a 20-year vision for the Central Lonsdale main street — protecting local businesses, active sidewalks and community character while planning for growth, with the first public-space improvements underway in 2026.

faq.q: How many units can a Central Lonsdale house lot hold?
faq.a: Under the GO Zone adopted December 8, 2025: up to 3 units on a lot of 280 m² or less, up to 4 units on a larger lot in Low Rise Neighbourhood 1, and up to 6 units in Low Rise Neighbourhood 2 or Residential Level 4 designations; a secondary suite may also combine with a coach house where the lot qualifies.
